about: USB-C 3D glasses known to Sparky Stereo OS, by the EDID identity they announce. One file, two readers: Stereo KWin reads it at build time (src/outputconfigurationstore.cpp, s_stereoGlasses) and the Windows glasses keeper embeds it. Checked by sparky-os/tests/check-stereo-glasses-table.py.
mode_rule: The first detailed timing of the EDID at twice the panel width means Full SBS; at the panel width it means 2D or Half SBS, which the cable cannot tell apart. The glasses' own Real 3D mode is 2D to the computer.

glasses.name: XREAL One Pro

states.note: byte-identical to the 2D dump: the glasses announce nothing for half side by side
a 2D to 3D conversion inside the glasses; one 1920x1080 picture to the computer

glasses.menu_path: double click X, Spatial Screen, 3D Mode, Full SBS

usb.note: the IMU link (XRLinuxDriver src/devices/xreal.c); not the display identity

glasses.source: EDIDs read from an owner's glasses on 24 Oct 2026, one per mode of the glasses' menu; Stereo KWin autotests/integration/data/xreal-one-pro-*.bin
